blocks.title: 💼 Interview Question & Model Answer
blocks.text:
**Q:** What is the objective of placing ₹1 Lakh Crore+ NBFCs under Upper Layer scale-based regulation?

**Model Answer:** Large NBFCs pose systemic bank-like contagion risks. Upper-layer norms impose bank-grade capital buffers and enhanced corporate governance.
